title: The long version of how I got here.
subtitle: A timeline of the moments, missteps, and milestones that turned 'curious kid with a laptop' into a full-stack engineer shipping software that businesses run on.

milestones.title: Started Computer Engineering
milestones.body: Began a B.E. in Computer Engineering at I.K.G. Punjab Technical University, and started writing code that had to work for someone other than me.

milestones.title: Committed to the full stack
milestones.body: Went deep on React on the front end and Spring Boot and Node on the back, deliberately refusing to specialise until I could carry a feature end to end.

milestones.title: Joined YPSS as a Full-Stack Web Developer
milestones.body: First production codebase with real users. Built the backend and two web apps running a national volunteer organization's operations across India.

milestones.title: Graduated, and shipped through it
milestones.body: Finished the B.E. with a 7.36 CGPA while running the org hierarchy, permission engine, and analytics dashboards at YPSS in parallel.

milestones.title: National-scale systems, daily use
milestones.body: Aadhaar OCR verification, exportable PDF/Excel analytics drilling down by zone and branch, real-time chat and push — used every day, across India, until I wrapped up in December.

milestones.title: Joined Totalsoft IT Solutions
milestones.body: Full stack across production SaaS for logistics and service-industry clients: live GPS fleet software under UK/EU transport law, multi-tenant garage SaaS, and a platform-wide billing and governance console.

values.title: Default to honesty.
values.body: If a deadline is unrealistic, I say so on day one. If a feature is the wrong call, I push back with options.

values.title: Bias to ship.
values.body: A live product teaches you more in a week than a Figma file teaches you in a month.

values.title: Sweat the seams.
values.body: Loading states, empty states, error states, keyboard support — the small stuff is the brand.
